news.titleEn: Oil slips more than 1% as talks continue on ending Iran war
news.conclusionEn: Brent fell about 1.4% to roughly $111.8 a barrel on Monday as Iranian and Qatari officials held a third straight day of talks aimed at ending the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗与卡塔尔连谈三天，布伦特原油周一跌约1.4%至111.8美元
news.whyEn: Oil above $100 feeds inflation worldwide; any deal to reopen Hormuz safely would sharply lower energy and shipping costs.
news.whyZh: 油价破百推高全球通胀，霍尔木兹若能安全重开，能源和航运成本将大幅回落
news.detailEn: Brent ended October at a six-month high on fears the conflict could escalate again after Tuesday's U.S. midterms. Iran's foreign minister called the talks with Qatari mediators "ongoing and progressing" while saying Tehran is ready for both defence and diplomacy. Analysts described Monday's drop as a technical pullback after strong gains, and attacks on tankers in the region continue. Traders warn that harsher rhetoric after the election could push Brent toward $120.
news.detailZh: 由于担心美国中期选举后冲突再度升级，布伦特原油10月收于六个月高点。伊朗外长称与卡塔尔调停方的会谈「正在进行且有进展」，同时表示德黑兰「防御与外交两手都准备好了」。分析师认为周一下跌只是前期大涨后的技术性回调，地区油轮遇袭仍在持续。交易员警告，选后若言辞升级，布伦特可能冲向120美元。

news.titleEn: Stock futures rebound ahead of busy week of earnings, jobs data and the midterm elections: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: U.S. stock futures rose early Monday after a losing week in which worries over AI spending sent the Nasdaq to its worst week in months and chip stocks sharply lower.
news.conclusionZh: AI支出担忧拖累科技股一周后，美股期货周一反弹
news.whyEn: This week packs the midterms, Apple and AMD earnings and the October jobs report, any of which could decide whether the tech selloff deepens.
news.whyZh: 本周有中期选举、苹果和AMD财报及非农数据，决定科技股抛售是否加深
news.detailEn: Nasdaq-100 futures gained about 0.9% after the index slumped on Friday as Alphabet and Microsoft guided capital spending lower and Amazon kept its outlook flat. Investors are questioning whether the AI buildout is generating enough return, while the Dow held up better thanks to rotation into defensive healthcare names. Apple reports after Monday's close, and Friday's payrolls report is expected to show only modest job gains. The week will test whether last week's risk-off mood was a pause or the start of a deeper correction.
news.detailZh: 上周五Alphabet和微软下调资本支出指引、亚马逊维持不变后，纳指大跌；周一纳指100期货回升约0.9%。投资者开始质疑AI基建的回报是否足够，而道指因资金转向医疗等防御板块表现较好。苹果将于周一盘后公布财报，周五的非农预计只会温和增长。这一周将检验上周的避险情绪只是暂停，还是更深调整的开始。

news.titleEn: Gulf region on edge as Qatar leads talks with Iran to stave off new U.S. attacks
news.conclusionEn: Gulf Arab officials met over the weekend and Qatar stepped up mediation with Iran, hoping to head off U.S. and Israeli strikes reportedly being planned for after Tuesday's midterms.
news.conclusionZh: 海湾国家密集斡旋，力图阻止美以在中期选举后对伊朗发动新打击
news.whyEn: A new round of strikes could re-close Hormuz and send oil, gas and shipping prices spiking again.
news.whyZh: 若再爆发打击，霍尔木兹可能再次封闭，油气和航运价格将再度飙升
news.detailEn: Qatar has led intense diplomacy over the past 72 hours to restart direct U.S.-Iran negotiations. Gulf states see Iran as a major threat but, as its neighbours, they bear the brunt of any retaliation against their airports, ports and energy sites. Even the UAE, the most hawkish Gulf state on Iran, does not want a wider war. Whether the talks hold after the midterms is now the key risk for energy markets.
news.detailZh: 过去72小时，卡塔尔主导密集外交，试图重启美伊直接谈判。海湾国家视伊朗为主要威胁，但作为邻国，一旦开战，它们的机场、港口和能源设施首当其冲。就连对伊朗立场最强硬的阿联酋也不希望战争扩大。中期选举后谈判能否维持，已成为能源市场最大的风险点。

news.titleEn: Dollar rangebound ahead of U.S. midterms; bitcoin reels from crypto heist
news.conclusionEn: The dollar index held near 101.9 as traders waited for Tuesday's U.S. midterms and a busy week of central bank decisions in the UK, Australia, Norway and Sweden.
news.conclusionZh: 美元指数守在101.9附近，市场静候美国中期选举和多国央行决议
news.whyEn: Control of Congress shapes U.S. fiscal policy, while an RBA hike is priced in, directly affecting Australian borrowers and the AUD.
news.whyZh: 国会控制权决定美国财政走向；市场已押注澳储行加息，直接影响澳洲房贷和澳元
news.detailEn: Democrats are widely expected to win the House, while Senate control is less certain. Markets expect Australia's cash rate to rise toward a near two-decade high of 4.85%, and the Bank of England meets on Thursday. The euro is languishing near $1.116 and the yen near 157.8 per dollar. Bitcoin hovered around $78,000 after last week's record Binance hack.
news.detailZh: 市场普遍预计民主党将拿下众议院，参议院归属则更不确定。市场预期澳洲现金利率将升至近20年高位4.85%，英国央行周四也将议息。欧元在1.116美元附近徘徊，日元约157.8兑1美元。受上周币安创纪录被盗影响，比特币在7.8万美元附近徘徊。

news.titleEn: OPEC+ Leaves Oil Output Targets Unchanged for December
news.conclusionEn: Seven key OPEC+ members led by Saudi Arabia and Russia agreed on Sunday to keep production quotas unchanged for December.
news.conclusionZh: 沙特、俄罗斯领衔的OPEC+七国决定12月产量配额不变
news.whyEn: With Gulf producers' exports constrained by the war, OPEC+ has little room to add supply to cool high prices.
news.whyZh: 战事限制海湾产油国出口，OPEC+难以靠增产给高油价降温
news.detailEn: The group finished unwinding its last voluntary cuts in September, so the decision means no further increases for now. Shipments through Hormuz are rising and Saudi Arabia's Red Sea export route picked up in October, but Gulf members still cannot fully use their higher targets. Holding quotas steady signals OPEC+ is waiting to see how the Iran conflict plays out. Prices therefore remain driven mainly by geopolitics rather than cartel policy.
news.detailZh: 该组织9月已退出最后一轮自愿减产，这次决定意味着暂不再增产。霍尔木兹海峡的运量在回升，沙特经红海的出口通道10月也有增加，但海湾成员国仍无法充分用足更高的配额。维持配额不变显示OPEC+在观望伊朗冲突走向。因此油价目前主要由地缘政治而非OPEC+政策驱动。

news.titleEn: Qatar LNG carrier struck by 'unidentified objects' in Gulf
news.conclusionEn: The Qatari LNG carrier Al Mayeda was hit by unidentified objects in the Gulf; no crew were hurt and the ship remains operational.
news.conclusionZh: 卡塔尔LNG运输船Al Mayeda在海湾遭不明物体击中，无人受伤
news.whyEn: Qatar is a top LNG exporter, so attacks on its carriers raise gas prices and insurance costs for importers in Asia and Europe.
news.whyZh: 卡塔尔是LNG出口大国，船只遇袭推高亚欧进口方的气价和保险费
news.detailEn: The vessel is operated by Nakilat, Qatar's gas shipping company, and Qatar condemned the attack as a threat to global energy security. More than 120 commercial vessels have been hit in the region since the war began in February. October was the worst month yet, with at least 29 vessels struck. Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Bahrain and the GCC all condemned the incident.
news.detailZh: 该船由卡塔尔天然气运输公司Nakilat运营，卡塔尔谴责这次袭击威胁全球能源安全。自2月战争爆发以来，该地区已有超过120艘商船遇袭。10月是情况最严重的一个月，至少29艘船被击中。沙特、阿联酋、巴林和海合会均对此事件表示谴责。

news.titleEn: China Reportedly Discusses Ways to Support Stocks With Banks
news.conclusionEn: China's three main financial regulators were reported to be meeting banks and brokers on Monday to discuss measures to support the stock market.
news.conclusionZh: 据报中国三大金融监管机构周一召集银行券商，商讨稳股市措施
news.whyEn: Beijing stepping in signals worry about market weakness and could lift Chinese equities and related Asian assets.
news.whyZh: 官方出手显示对市场疲软的担忧，或提振A股及相关亚洲资产
news.detailEn: The People's Bank of China, the National Financial Regulatory Administration and the China Securities Regulatory Commission are discussing how to optimise lending programmes that fund share buybacks. The move follows a softer official manufacturing PMI for October and a global tech selloff. China's CSI 300 rose on Monday as investors reacted. Details of any new measures will show how much support Beijing is willing to provide.
news.detailZh: 中国人民银行、国家金融监督管理总局和中国证监会正在讨论如何优化支持股票回购的再贷款等工具。此前10月官方制造业PMI走弱，全球科技股也遭抛售。周一沪深300指数上涨，反映投资者对此的反应。新措施的具体内容将显示北京愿意托市的力度。

news.titleEn: Binance withdrawals resume following $6 billion hack
news.conclusionEn: Binance began a phased restart of withdrawals on Sunday after a record $6.3 billion theft attributed to North Korean hackers, saying it will absorb the losses.
news.conclusionZh: 币安遭朝鲜黑客盗走63亿美元后，周日分阶段恢复提币
news.whyEn: How the world's largest crypto exchange handles the crisis will shape trust and liquidity across the whole crypto market.
news.whyZh: 全球最大交易所的应对方式，将影响整个加密市场的信任与流动性
news.detailEn: The FBI attributed the theft to TraderTraitor, a North Korean state-backed hacking group. Binance reopened withdrawals for 15 assets, including Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana, and is covering losses from its user protection fund, treasury and insurance fund. Bloomberg reported about $3.6 billion in net outflows after withdrawals restarted. More assets will be restored in phases as security checks are completed.
news.detailZh: FBI认定此次盗窃由朝鲜国家支持的黑客组织TraderTraitor所为。币安先恢复了比特币、以太坊、Solana等15种资产的提币，并用用户保护基金、公司资金和保险基金弥补损失。据彭博报道，恢复提币后净流出约36亿美元。其余资产将在安全检查完成后分批恢复。

news.titleEn: Russian strikes cut power to thousands in Ukraine as drones damage Russian facility
news.conclusionEn: Overnight Russian strikes knocked out power in four Ukrainian regions, while Ukrainian drones hit industrial sites in Russia as a local ceasefire near Oleshky ended.
news.conclusionZh: 俄军夜袭致乌克兰四地区停电，乌无人机反击俄工业设施
news.whyEn: Attacks on energy infrastructure ahead of winter deepen Ukraine's power deficit and show that peace efforts remain fragile.
news.whyZh: 入冬前打击能源设施加剧乌电力短缺，也显示和平努力仍很脆弱
news.detailEn: Ukraine's air force said it shot down 371 of 433 long-range drones launched since Saturday evening. Ukraine hit the Kamensky plant in Russia's Rostov region, which Zelenskyy said makes missiles, and an industrial site in Nizhny Novgorod. A six-day local truce around Oleshky expired without being extended. Kyiv is pushing for a full energy ceasefire, which Moscow has refused.
news.detailZh: 乌克兰空军称，自周六晚以来俄方发射的433架远程无人机中有371架被击落。乌方袭击了俄罗斯罗斯托夫州的卡缅斯基工厂（泽连斯基称其生产导弹）以及下诺夫哥罗德的一处工业设施。奥列什基周边为期六天的局部停火到期，未获延长。基辅一直推动全面的能源设施停火，但遭莫斯科拒绝。

news.titleEn: New Zealand Stocks, Dollar Slide as Tight Election Raises Policy Uncertainty
news.conclusionEn: New Zealand stocks have lost momentum and the kiwi dollar has fallen about 6% since late August ahead of a too-close-to-call election on Nov. 7.
news.conclusionZh: 11月7日大选胶着，新西兰股市乏力，纽元8月底以来跌约6%
news.whyEn: A hung result could mean drawn-out coalition talks and policy uncertainty for investors and businesses dealing with New Zealand.
news.whyZh: 若无多数党，组阁谈判可能拖长，给投资者和对新业务带来政策不确定性
news.detailEn: The S&P/NZX 50 has cooled since hitting a record in August as polls show a close race. Recent surveys put the Opportunity Party in a kingmaker position, with Prime Minister Luxon's National Party slipping. Higher oil prices and a fragile economy are also weighing on the kiwi. The New Zealand dollar recently posted its biggest drop against the Australian dollar in years as rate paths diverge.
news.detailZh: 由于民调显示选情胶着，S&P/NZX 50指数自8月创纪录后明显降温。最新民调显示机会党（Opportunity Party）可能成为「造王者」，总理卢克森领导的国家党支持率下滑。油价走高和经济疲弱也在拖累纽元。随着两国利率路径分化，纽元兑澳元近期录得多年来最大跌幅。

businessTips.explanationEn: A force majeure clause excuses a party from performing a contract when an extraordinary event beyond its control, such as war, natural disaster or government action, makes performance impossible or impractical. It only protects you if the event is covered by the wording, so the list of events and the notice requirements matter. Courts usually read these clauses narrowly, and higher costs alone rarely count. Reviewing them before a crisis is far easier than arguing about them during one.
businessTips.explanationZh: 不可抗力条款允许合同一方在发生战争、自然灾害、政府行为等无法控制的特殊事件、导致无法或难以履约时免责。只有当事件被条款措辞覆盖时才能获得保护，所以列举的事件范围和通知要求非常关键。法院通常会严格解释，仅仅成本上升一般不算。危机来临前审查这些条款，远比危机中争论容易。
businessTips.exampleEn: Shipowners hit by Gulf attacks may invoke force majeure to delay deliveries, while buyers check whether "acts of war" are covered. A small importer can ask suppliers to define notice periods and alternative arrangements before signing.
businessTips.exampleZh: 海湾遇袭的船东可能援引不可抗力延迟交货，买方则会核对「战争行为」是否在条款之内。小型进口商可以在签约前要求供应商写明通知期限和替代安排。

businessTips.explanationEn: Instead of invoicing only when a project is finished, you collect a deposit upfront and bill the rest at agreed milestones. This protects your cash flow, filters out non-serious clients and reduces the damage if a client disappears. It also makes scope changes easier to price, because each milestone has a defined deliverable. For small businesses, getting paid early is often worth more than a slightly higher price.
businessTips.explanationZh: 不是等项目做完才开票，而是先收定金，剩余款项按约定的里程碑分阶段收取。这能保护现金流、筛掉不认真的客户，并在客户「失联」时减少损失。由于每个里程碑都有明确交付物，需求变更也更容易定价。对小生意来说，早收钱往往比价格稍高更有价值。
businessTips.exampleEn: A freelance designer charges 40% upfront for a brand package, 30% after the logo is approved and 30% on final files. A cleaning business can take a booking deposit to reduce last-minute cancellations.
businessTips.exampleZh: 自由设计师做品牌套餐时先收40%定金，Logo确认后收30%，交付终稿再收30%。清洁生意可以收取预约定金，减少临时取消。

businessTips.term: Buy the Rumor, Sell the News
businessTips.explanationEn: This market saying describes prices rising in anticipation of an expected event, then falling once the event actually happens. Because markets price in expectations early, the news itself often brings no fresh buyers, and traders take profits. It is a reminder that what matters is the outcome versus expectations, not whether the news is good. Big scheduled events like elections, earnings and IPOs often show this pattern.
businessTips.explanationZh: 这句市场俗语指价格在预期事件发生前上涨，事件真正落地后反而下跌。因为市场会提前消化预期，消息本身往往带不来新的买家，交易者还会趁机获利了结。它提醒我们：关键是结果与预期的差距，而不是消息本身好坏。选举、财报、IPO等已知重大事件常出现这种走势。
businessTips.exampleEn: If markets already expect one party to win the midterms, a confirmed win may barely move or even lower stocks. Similarly, a company can beat earnings estimates and still fall if investors expected an even bigger beat.
businessTips.exampleZh: 如果市场已经预期某党赢得中期选举，结果确认后股市可能几乎不动甚至下跌。同样，公司财报超预期，若投资者原本期待更大幅度的超预期，股价也可能下跌。
